traffic:trace.missingTitle: This trace is no longer in the buffer
traffic:trace.missingText: The buffer keeps only the most recent requests, and a restart clears it. Open the list for what it holds now.
traffic:trace.errorTitle: The trace could not be read

traffic:trace.whyStatus: The server answered {p0} and recorded no error text.

traffic:trace.timelineNone: No backend operation was recorded while this request was open.
traffic:trace.noBodyText: No body was kept for this request.
traffic:trace.hidden: Hidden until you reveal it: bodies can hold prompts and personal data.
traffic:trace.truncated: Showing {p0} of {p1}: the body was capped when it was recorded.
traffic:backend.audio.title: Audio Snippet

traffic:middleware.title: Middleware
traffic:middleware.lede: What a request passes through, in this order.
traffic:middleware.orderNote: Select a step to see only its rules. The server fixes the order and it cannot be rearranged.
traffic:middleware.piiIntro: Redaction is per model and runs on the request. It is off by default. Backends that match
traffic:middleware.piiIntro2: default to on (cloud passthroughs). A model opts in with pii.enabled and a list of detectors, and each detector is a token_classify model whose pii_detection block sets the policy.
traffic:middleware.noopTitle: Enabled but no detector resolved, so nothing is scanned. Switch on a detector's Default below, or add pii.detectors to the model.
traffic:middleware.addDetectorTitle: Add a NER or pattern detector model
traffic:middleware.detectorsIntro: These token_classify models do the scanning. Switch Default on to apply a detector to any PII-enabled model that names none of its own, mostly cloud-proxy and TLS-proxy models. A model's own pii.detectors always wins.
traffic:middleware.missingDetector: This default detector names a model that is not loaded.
traffic:middleware.noDetectors: No detector models loaded. Add one with the button above (a token_classify NER model or a built-in secret pattern model).
traffic:middleware.cachedDecision: Cached decision. Per-label scores are not recorded: the cache stores only the resulting label set.
traffic:middleware.fallbackDecision: Out-of-corpus fallback. The nearest labelled corpus entry was at similarity {p0}, below the router's gate. Seed examples near this kind of prompt to route it.
traffic:middleware.noScores: No per-label scores were recorded for this decision (likely a fallback row).
traffic:middleware.activation: Activation threshold {p0}%. The marker on each bar shows it.
traffic:middleware.noRoutersText: Add a router block to a model YAML to enable routing. The classifier picks one of the listed candidates for each request, and the usual model resolution then runs on the chosen target.
traffic:middleware.addRouterTitle: Open the model editor with the Routing Model template
traffic:middleware.routersNote: Edit the router model's YAML to change candidates or rules.
traffic:middleware.noDecisions: No routing decisions yet. Send a request to a router model to fill this log.
traffic:middleware.label: Label
traffic:middleware.expand: Click to see the per-label score breakdown
traffic:middleware.proxyUnavailableText: The status endpoint did not return a proxy section.
traffic:middleware.conflictTitle: TLS proxy disabled: duplicate host claims
traffic:middleware.conflictText: Each intercept host must be owned by exactly one model config. Edit the conflicting model YAML files to resolve it.
traffic:middleware.proxyIntro: The TLS proxy terminates TLS for allowlisted hosts so PII redaction can run on traffic from clients that sign in with OAuth or a subscription (Claude Code, Codex CLI). Other hosts get a plain CONNECT tunnel with no inspection and no CA trust needed.
traffic:middleware.hostsClaimed: Hosts claimed by model configs (PII settings come from the owning config):
traffic:middleware.noHosts: No model config declares an intercept host. Without one, every CONNECT tunnels through unchanged. Create one from the Add Model page with the MITM Intercept template.
traffic:middleware.noCa: The CA is not generated yet. Start the listener to generate it.
traffic:middleware.addProxyModelTitle: Open the model editor with the MITM Intercept template
traffic:middleware.noProxyModels: No model config declares mitm.hosts. Use Add MITM model: the template defaults to api.anthropic.com with PII filtering on.
traffic:middleware.listenHint: Bind address for the proxy listener. Empty disables it. Bind to 127.0.0.1:port unless only clients you control can reach it: the CONNECT port has no auth. Clients connect to the proxy over plain HTTP (use http://, even in HTTPS_PROXY), and the proxy terminates TLS for allowlisted hosts inside the tunnel.
traffic:middleware.interceptNote: Intercept hosts are declared per model in the model YAML under mitm.hosts. Each host is owned by one model config, and PII filtering and pattern overrides come from that config.
traffic:middleware.setup2: Trust it on the client. For Node-based CLIs (Claude Code, Codex):
traffic:middleware.setup3: Point the client at the proxy:
traffic:middleware.setup3b: (yes, http://: clients speak plain HTTP to the proxy, which then terminates TLS for allowlisted hosts on the inner connection).
traffic:middleware.admissionText: Requests over a key's rate limit or a quota are refused before they reach a model. Limits are set per user and key. LocalAI shows the refusals below as events, and has no list of admission rules to show here.
traffic:middleware.admissionNone: No refusal in the recent events.
traffic:middleware.eventsSub: shared by the PII filter, the proxy and admission, newest first, capped at 100
traffic:middleware.subject: Subject
traffic:middleware.noEventsText: Events appear when a PII detector flags an entity, when the proxy decides whether to intercept a hostname, or when an intercepted request finishes. Request bodies are never stored. Use the API and backend traces for those.
traffic:middleware.knnEmptyTitle: Seed labelled example prompts via POST /api/router/\{name\}/corpus. Every request falls back until the corpus has entries near it.
traffic:middleware.knnTitle: {p2} labelled examples; the {p0} nearest vote; entries below similarity {p1} cannot vote (prompts outside the corpus use the fallback)
traffic:prometheus.title: Prometheus
traffic:prometheus.lede: LocalAI exposes metrics in the Prometheus text format. Scrape them into your own Prometheus or Grafana.
traffic:prometheus.auth: GET /metrics is admin only. Give your scraper an admin API key as a Bearer token. The route does not exist when LocalAI runs with LOCALAI_DISABLE_METRICS_ENDPOINT.
traffic:prometheus.scrape.ok_one: This server answers. It exposes {p0} metric family.
traffic:prometheus.scrape.ok_other: This server answers. It exposes {p0} metric families.
traffic:prometheus.scrape.off: This server does not serve /metrics. Metrics are switched off.
traffic:prometheus.scrape.denied: This server refused the request. The route needs an admin account.
traffic:prometheus.metric.apiCall: Request duration in seconds, by HTTP method and route. The only metric that is always on.
traffic:prometheus.metric.tokens: Tokens accounted, by user, served model and kind (prompt or completion).
traffic:prometheus.metric.billed: Requests accounted, by user, served model and endpoint.
traffic:prometheus.metric.cost: Cost accounted in USD, by user and served model.
traffic:prometheus.metric.unrecorded: Requests that finished but produced no usage record. A rising count means a gap in accounting.
traffic:prometheus.metric.pii: PII and audit events, by kind, origin, action and direction.
traffic:prometheus.metric.failoverUp: 1 when a failover target is healthy, 0 when it is not.
traffic:prometheus.metric.compressionEve: Chat context compression attempts, by model and result.
traffic:prometheus.metric.prefixCache: Prefix-cache forced-disturb events started by this frontend.
traffic:prometheus.conditional: Only api_call is always present. The others appear while the feature behind them runs, so "not seen yet" is not an error. The server also exposes the Go runtime and process metrics of the client library.
traffic:prometheus.other: {p0} other metric families on this server
traffic:prometheus.missing1: Status and model on a request: api_call carries the method and the route only.
traffic:prometheus.missing2: GPU utilisation, GPU temperature and CPU: use the host's own exporter for those.
traffic:prometheus.missing3: Latency percentiles: the histogram carries buckets, and Prometheus works out the percentile when you query it.
traffic:prometheus.exampleNote: The 95th percentile of request duration over 5 minutes, across all routes.
